questions.question: Right after the small caption 'you build' appears, what single large bold caption word is shown next?
When the speaker says 'start with saving money', which word in the on-screen caption is shown in bold?
How many different everyday situations does the speaker give advice for when you are unsure what to do (the examples, not the final conclusion)?
While he says 'when that thing comes', in which direction does his arm and pointing hand move across the frame?
questions.answer: He points and extends his arm out toward the left edge of the frame (the viewer's left).

questions.question: After the large caption 'potential' at the very end, what does his raised arm do?
questions.answer: It drops down and comes to rest low in front of him (near his lap).

questions.question: When the speaker says 'don't stay up late', what is his hand doing?
questions.answer: His fist is raised in front of his face, covering his nose and mouth.
